offers_products.reason: Sells secondhand clothing, accessories, housewares, books and electronics through its thrift stores.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from retail sales of used goods; nonprofit purchasing and recycling are part of sourcing, not main services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Thrift store shoppers buy used clothing and home goods for themselves.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Nonprofits are suppliers paid for donated goods; shoppers are individuals, with minimal wholesale of unsold goods.

recurring_revenue.reason: Shoppers make frequent repeat purchases of low-priced secondhand goods, encouraged by the Super Savers Club loyalty program.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discount secondhand apparel and household goods tend to hold up or gain when budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: Typical purchases are low-priced clothing and household items bought frequently.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for goods sold in retail stores, not for staff time or skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual households shopping at thrift stores.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs a large network of thrift stores plus processing centers, needing ongoing investment in leased and new locations.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call: stores are mostly leased, but the retail network and processing facilities need ongoing investment.
